AI agent memory needs a rollback button.

Memoria is a persistent memory layer for AI agents that brings Git-style version control to long-term memory.

It helps you make agent memory safer to change by tracking every memory mutation through snapshots, branches, merges, audit trails, and point-in-time rollback, backed by MatrixOne’s Copy-on-Write engine.

Key features:

• Git-style memory versioning – snapshot, branch, merge, and roll back memory changes instead of treating memory as an append-only blob
• Hybrid retrieval – combines vector and full-text search so agents can find memories by meaning and keywords
• Self-governing memory – detects contradictions, quarantines low-confidence memories, and keeps provenance trails
• Private deployment options – use Memoria Cloud or self-host with Docker, with a local embedding option for keeping data on your machine
• MCP-compatible setup – works with agent tools like Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kiro, and OpenClaw

It’s open-source under the Apache License 2.0.
